integrity: Proof includes analytic marginal-gain argument and a finite exhaustive cross-check; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The structural classification covers disjoint unions of cliques, not every graph.
The all-graph sharp first-order census covers at most five vertices.
Edges are simple, unweighted, and contribute one OR-activated feature; general coverage hyperedges and weighted edges are excluded.
A full bibliographic uniqueness claim is not established; unindexed graph heuristic work could overlap.
title: A sharp five-player Shapley-ranking obstruction in graph coverage games
